scope.summary: W4 driver gains a bounded row_contains matcher; the top_queries live-cursor marker case uses the new sql_text filter plus row_contains instead of asserting the marker is the global rank-1 cursor.

entry_points.name: W4 external client, release binary
entry_points.trace: Release binary built with cargo build --release -p oraclemcp --bin oraclemcp in a clean git-archive export of 32024974 (export HEAD = 32024974, status clean), sha256 0431dd14bdd2976211584eb054bb322f3c6c62b433a9271400081c645b45851f. --case w4_top_queries_live_cursor_cache_contains_marker pass stdio+http on free23, xe21, xe18; python3 scripts/e2e/w4/driver.py --selftest pass (includes row_contains positive and the planted absent-marker rejection).

limitations: The case no longer proves the marker ranks first in the unfiltered cursor cache (that was not deterministic on a shared lab); it proves the marker cursor is present and returned by the filtered top-SQL read.

The full ops-tools family was not proven green at 32024974: a scoped invocation of all 29 ops ids aborted on every lane with 'failed to drop before profile switch' (oracle_set_session_level drop did not report READ_ONLY) before producing results; the marker case itself passed in isolation. Stdio-only ops cases also cannot be selected with --case at 32024974 (see oraclemcp-mls32).
